tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page ground. Stage: behind the globe on World and Engine. Paper: the Bulletin's statement-grid grey, behind sheets and cards.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Solid surfaces: the clock face sector, newsflash card, statement cards, and HUD panels when reduced transparency is on.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: HUD panels floating over the globe, blurred. 0.64 copies the Bulletin's 60% black over timeline photographs.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: panel edges, ticker rules, card edges. Below 3:1 on purpose, so it never carries meaning on its own.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (buttons, segmented controls). At least 3:1 on ground and raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, the clock hand, the time spine, REAL marks. Stage value is the Bulletin's own text-on-photo grey. On ground, raised and scrim.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: sub-lines, inactive tabs, key years on the spine. On ground, raised and scrim.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text and minor marks: minor years, timestamps, the mock mark, GAME RULE labels. 4.5:1 on ground and raised in both themes.

tokens.name: oxblood
tokens.usage: The clock's voice, as a fill only: newsflash band, primary button, the two short rules framing a sheet title. Text on it uses on-oxblood. Never a text colour on Stage (2:1).

tokens.name: on-oxblood
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an oxblood fill (9.9:1).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Links, outline buttons and the active tab underline. Ink on Stage so red there only ever means toward midnight; oxblood on Paper, as the Bulletin's 'View Full Statement'.

tokens.name: alarm
tokens.usage: Toward midnight: the Rogue AI, catastrophe marks, the midnight point on the face, and your timeline where it runs earlier than the real forecast. Text-safe on ground and raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ward
tokens.usage: Away from midnight: the Guardian, oversight, and your timeline where it runs later than the real forecast. Always paired with a word or glyph, never hue alone.

tokens.name: sim
tokens.usage: SIMULATED provenance only: anything MiroFish made up (X feed, government events, news) and the projected part of the time bar. Pair with a hollow or dashed form.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: display-1
styles.usage: One per sheet: the sheet title, centred between two 360px oxblood rules. The Bulletin sets 'The Clock Shifts' this way at 60px.

styles.name: display-2
styles.usage: Section heads inside a sheet and the end-screen verdict.

styles.name: display-3
styles.usage: Newsflash headline. The only serif allowed on Stage.

styles.name: reading
styles.usage: The clock's reading line, title case, as the Bulletin's '85 Seconds to Midnight'. Also step headlines in a sheet.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Markets put the chance of a frontier model escaping oversight at 39% by 2028.
styles.usage: Running text in sheets, max 64 characters a line.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: until Dec 2032, when the chance of AI catastrophe passes 1 in 10
styles.usage: HUD text, ticker items, card copy.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: The line under a clock thumbnail. The floor for any text is 12px.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase. Tabs and band labels, as the Bulletin's 'THE CLOCK SHIFTS' tabs: active ink, inactive ink-3.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase. The three provenance labels and nothing else.

styles.name: numeral-xl
styles.usage: The active year on a time spine, one at a time. The Bulletin's 75px bold italic year.

styles.name: numeral-l
styles.usage: Key years on the spine (a milestone or a move landed) and the year on a statement card.

styles.name: numeral-s
styles.usage: Every other year on the spine, in ink-3.

styles.name: countdown
styles.usage: The live countdown under the face. Tabular figures, sans, not mono.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Timestamps, source ids, seeds and run numbers. Never headlines.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: The base unit (the Bulletin's own). Gap between a label's dot and its word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and between stacked lines in a HUD panel.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between controls in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: HUD panel padding, button side padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen gutter: every HUD corner sits this far from the edges.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a sheet.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Sheet side padding, gap between statement cards.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Above and below a sheet title block.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Left inset of the replay spine column, as the Bulletin's timeline.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Buttons, sheets, statement cards, newsflash. The Bulletin's buttons are square.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: HUD panels and chips: square in feel, softened just enough over the globe.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Spine nodes, label dots and map rings only.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: Stage: HUD panels and newsflash over the globe. Paper: statement cards on the grey ground. Nothing else casts a shadow.
